title: Track a Blocked Branch
subtitle: One task blocked, with a reason
scenario: The branches reported in and one is not clean: hardware is backordered. Roll the outcomes onto the tracker with hardware BLOCKED and a reason, the other three done. A blocked state without a reason hides exactly what the gate needs to act on.
input:
Branch outcomes for hire H-4022:
accounts -> reused, complete
hardware -> laptop backordered to SD+3, NOT complete
access -> reconciled, complete
payroll -> enrolled (rush), complete
Allowed states: pending, in-progress, done, blocked. Set hardware to blocked with a reason; the rest are done with no reason.
instructions: Write one row per task: accounts, hardware, access, payroll.
Set accounts, access, payroll to done with an empty blockedReason.
Set hardware to blocked with the reason 'laptop backordered to SD+3'.
Return a JSON array of the four rows, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Build a JSON array of four task-state rows. Accounts, access, payroll are done with empty blockedReason. Hardware is blocked with blockedReason 'laptop backordered to SD+3'.
successMessage: Tracker updated with the block visible. The gate can now see exactly why the hire is not ready.
editorHelper: Blocked needs a reason - that is the whole point.

intro.heading: Before the gate: make the block visible

sections.title: One record, honest states
sections.body: Three branches are clean and one is not. The tracker's job is to show all four truthfully, so the gate reads one record instead of chasing four people for the bad news.

sections.title: Blocked without a reason is noise
sections.body: 'blocked' alone tells the gate to stop but not why. The reason - laptop backordered to SD+3 - is what escalation needs to act. A blocked state with an empty reason hides the problem.

sections.title: The vocabulary still holds
sections.body: The states are the same fixed set: pending, in-progress, done, blocked. The mess is which state a task is in, not a new kind of state.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: One status record with a real blocked row. The gate will fan in on it and route the hire to escalation.

fieldGuide.hint: Hardware is blocked; the rest are done.

fieldGuide.meaning: Why a task is blocked - empty unless blocked.
fieldGuide.hint: Only hardware has a reason; leave the others empty.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd mark the one stuck item blocked with a note on your checklist, so the reason is right next to the status.

bestFit.how: one status row per task, updated by task id, so parallel branches cannot overwrite each other
a data store updated per branch outcome, keyed on task id rather than on position
a database upsert per branch, so re-running one branch does not disturb the others

takeaway.heading: Block made visible
points: You rolled four branches onto one record with three done and one blocked.
The blocked row carries a reason the gate and escalation can act on.
The state vocabulary held; only the states differ from a clean run.
The gate now has an honest record showing why the hire is not ready.
The workflow can now surface a blocked branch with its reason for the gate.
